shape: Two-portal arena with center super-hub (N+S gates)
description: Two-portal arena where the center anchor (6uo9ly) is a high-degree super-hub fanning out to 5 interior anchors (west, west-south, south-center, north-center, east-mid) plus both entry hubs. The south route goes through a south-center clique (j182ab + 3vjxc5 + xy3sme + 2mtse8); the north route through runfb4. East and west pockets hang off center.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-4.91, -23.82) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.south: spawn_south at (5.19, 20.55) — gate on the south (high-Z) side

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → north_inner → center → south_c → south_inner → spawn_south. 5 hops.
DISPATCH RULE: center is the canonical dispatch anchor — reaches 5 detour anchors. Use the center for cross-zone objective dispatch.
south_c is a secondary hub covering the south-east corner.
Two single-degree pockets (east_mid via north_c, west_pocket via north_inner/center) — corner objectives.
